changelog: NEW (dev only): Top-right avatar button on the home screen. D-pad UP from any content row focuses it; press Enter to jump to the 'Who's watching?' picker; D-pad DOWN takes you back to the page's first content card.

NEW (dev only): Settings → PROFILE section with two clear entries: 'Switch Profile' (currently watching as ___) and 'Manage Profiles' (add/rename/avatar/delete). The original Xtream-account 'Switch Profile' entry is renamed to 'Switch Xtream Account' so the two never get confused.
INHERITED v1.44.138-debug: Netflix-style multi-profile (5 max, 36 avatars, Kids profile, per-profile sync).
